newsitem.title: USA: WMX says suit seeks to halt tender offer.
newsitem.headline: WMX says suit seeks to halt tender offer.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said Tuesday a class-action lawsuit was filed against the company and its board seeking to halt it from completing a recently announced Dutch-auction tender offer as well as to recover alleged damages and attorney fees.
It said the suit, filed in the Court of Chancery in New Castle County, Del., alleges that WMX failed to disclose material information in its offer to buy shares from stockholders.
WMX said it intends to oppose the lawsuit "vigorously."
WMX said it believes its offer to purchase contains all material information required for stockholders to make an informed decision concerning tender of shares.
It said a hearing on the suit's preliminary injunction request is expected to occur by the middle of the week of April 21.

WMX's approximately $1 billion offer to buy up to 30 million of its common stock, or about 6.2 percent of the outstanding shares, is currently scheduled to close on April 28. WMX said the price range of its offer will be from $30 to $35 per share. The offer began April 1.
